subject.title: fix(session): stop repeated restart recovery after retry budget

question: Should main-session restart recovery use this PR's cumulative accepted-attempt fuse as the canonical persisted recovery policy for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/95750?
rationale: The change adds new persisted SessionEntry state and intentionally changes automatic recovery from unbounded cross-boot retries to fail-closed tombstoning after accepted attempts, which requires maintainer ownership of the operator-facing recovery contract.

options.title: Accept this durable fuse
options.body: Treat this branch as the canonical fix, require any final exact-head CI and owner review, and close or supersede the older overlapping PR after landing.

options.title: Prefer narrower flat counter
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96083 or a smaller variant instead, accepting less shared fuse reuse and weaker race handling.

options.title: Defer recovery policy
options.body: Keep both PRs open until maintainers decide whether tombstoning exhausted automatic recovery is the desired product behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept this durable fuse
recommendation.body: Treat this branch as the canonical fix, require any final exact-head CI and owner review, and close or supersede the older overlapping PR after landing.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned and already shaped the durable-fuse review direction for this PR.
